title: Trade row
description: One row of out/<portfolio>/trades.csv and the <portfolio> trades tab (settled and open).

schema_version.description: report layout version; the app accepts major 1

result.description: won, lost, or open (not settled yet)

pnl_usd.description: realized P&L after fees; null while open

mark_bid_cents.description: open trade: average sale price per contract walking the recorded bids of its side for mark_contracts, cents; null when settled, unmarked or the bid side is empty

mark_mid_cents.description: reference only, not used for P&L: (best bid + best ask) / 2 on the trade's side, cents

mark_contracts.description: contracts the recorded bids cover (at most contracts); the rest have no bids and are valued at $0 (mark_contracts < contracts flags a pending loss)

mark_value_usd.description: liquidation value: proceeds of selling mark_contracts at the recorded bids now, after the taker exit fee, plus $0 for the contracts without bids (0 when the bid side is empty)

unrealized_pnl_usd.description: mark_value_usd minus entry cost (price x contracts + entry fee); set whenever the trade is marked

marked_at.description: time of the snapshot priced (at most 15 minutes before as_of); null when settled or unmarked

excluded.description: excluded from statistics (nem trade exclude): left out of every win rate, edge and verdict, and of P&L, equity and risk limits (treated as never taken); written true/false (CSV text "true"/"false"), null only when an older 1.x file lacks the column (read as false)

exclude_reason.description: why the trade was excluded, as given to nem trade exclude; null when counted
